newsitem.title: UK: Ex-Jaguar boss Robinson made UK Paymaster-General.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Jaguar boss Robinson made UK Paymaster-General.

text.p: Geoffrey Robinson, a former chief executive of British car maker Jaguar, was appointed Paymaster-General at the Treasury with responsibility for the Private Finance Initiative, a government spokesman said.
The PFI seeks to lure private cash into public infrastructure projects.

Robinson, a multi-millionaire businessman, last held a front bench seat in 1987 when he was Labour's trade and industry spokesman. Last year he bought the loss-making left-wing New Statesman magazine.
Former Scottish affairs spokeswoman Helen Liddell was made a minister of state at the Treasury.
